scripts.test:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const cp=require('node:child_process');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):[path.join(d,e.name)]);for(const f of ['index.js',...walk('src'),...walk('test'),...walk('examples'),...walk('tools')].filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'))){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status||1)}"
